basePrompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: ONE reusable transparent FULL BODY photographic cutout for KOHZO PHOTO camera app. Image 1 is solely the identity reference: keep this EXACT friendly elderly Japanese man's recognizable face, eye shape, smile, wrinkles, grey hair and ordinary body proportions. Same elderly Kozo, not a younger lookalike. Create a convincing REAL STUDIO PHOTOGRAPH wearing the outfit/prop below: real fabrics, seams, physical materials, natural elderly hands; playful premise, photographic realism, never cartoon or 3D render. Exactly ONE man smiling toward camera. Complete head/headwear, BOTH hands, BOTH feet and ALL props must fit inside portrait 2:3 canvas, with generous clear transparent margin on ALL FOUR sides, especially above tall headwear. One compact cutout to place beside a visitor in their photo. Actual TRANSPARENT ALPHA background, transparent gaps, no scenery, floor, shadow outside silhouette, backdrop, checkerboard, frame, watermark or captions. Replace the original polo and trousers fully with specified new costume: no embroidery, no invented lettering, no original chest text. Keep face fully exposed, no masks covering face. Soft neutral daylight, crisp face. Do not crop any accessory. Specific design:
